sections.body:
### 🏢 Enterprise Applications

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              GENERATIVE AI APPLICATIONS                  │
├──────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  CUSTOMER SERVICE│  Chatbots, FAQ automation, ticket     │
│                  │  routing, sentiment analysis          │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  CONTENT         │  Marketing copy, blog posts,          │
│  CREATION        │  product descriptions, social media   │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  CODE ASSISTANT  │  Code completion, bug fixing,         │
│                  │  code review, documentation           │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DATA ANALYSIS   │  Natural language to SQL, report      │
│                  │  generation, data summarization       │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DOCUMENT        │  Contract analysis, PDF summarization, │
│  PROCESSING      │  information extraction               │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤
│  SEARCH          │  Semantic search, Q&A over documents, │
│                  │  knowledge bases (RAG)                │
└──────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 🎯 Application Categories

**1. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**
> Upload your company's 1000-page manual → Ask questions in plain English → LLM answers using YOUR documents

**2. AI Agents**
> LLM that can take actions (browse web, run code, send emails, call APIs) autonomously

**3. Code Generation**
> Describe what you want in English → Get working code back

**4. Multimodal Apps**
> Upload an image → Ask questions about it → Get text answers
